answer: Here is one mechanism that works: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because fable only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, lantern is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any island approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
